title: OR-Select: Reproducible Best-of-N Answer Selection over LLM Ensembles, with an Exact Kemeny Reference and a Ground-Truth Audit
description: Code, stored run files and graded results for every track except GPQA Diamond, generated tables and historical pre-registration documents accompanying the manuscript. Stored judgments support offline selector replay where present. GPQA Diamond files embed password-gated question text and are not included; the released workflow can generate new runs with authorized benchmark access, not recreate the original stochastic outputs. The published v1.0.0 archive is distinct from later working-tree manuscript revisions.
